stories.title: The five NFL teams most likely to improve this season: Why the Chiefs lead Barnwell's annual list
stories.summary: Can the Giants and Jets improve on their awful 2025 records? Will the Chiefs, Lions and Ravens all make it back to the playoffs?

stories.title: Pro athletes planning to return to NCAA irks SEC
stories.summary: As LSU hopes to sign NFL tight end Dae'Quan Wright, if he clears waivers, the SEC on Monday issued a statement emphasizing its belief that athletes who choose to leave to sign pro contracts "should not then be permitted to return to college competition."

stories.title: Us or them: Kiffin defends pursuit of NFL players
stories.summary: LSU's Lane Kiffin defended his decision to pursue NFL rookies seeking a fifth year of playing college football, saying he's just one of many coaches trying to do so.

stories.title: Luis cleared to play for LSU after signing NBA deals
stories.summary: A Louisiana judge on Monday granted RJ Luis Jr., the 2025 Big East Player of the Year, a temporary injunction to play for LSU this season despite signing multiple NBA contracts.

stories.title: Niners owner York arrested in prostitution case
stories.summary: 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to a pair of misdemeanor charges after being arrested in Ohio on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.
